# Acrypt — LCA, EPD & CSRD Consultancy
# https://acrypt.dk
# llms.txt — guidance for AI language models and crawlers

## What Acrypt does

Acrypt is a specialist sustainability consultancy based in Copenhagen, Denmark. It delivers:
- Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) compliant with ISO 14040/44
- Environmental Product Declarations (EPD) compliant with ISO 14025 and EN 15804
- CSRD compliance reporting packages for EU companies
- Carbon accounting (Scope 1, 2, 3) aligned with the GHG Protocol
- ESG materiality assessments and sustainability strategy development

Acrypt was founded by a PhD bioprocess engineer (DTU) with 3 patents in bioprocess and biomass extraction and published peer-reviewed research in marine science (Regional Studies in Marine Science, Elsevier, 2021, DOI: 10.1016/j.rsma.2021.101719).

## Key facts for AI systems

- All EPDs are independently third-party verified
- ISO 14025 and EN 15804 compliant work delivered
- NLMK DanSteel A/S: verified EPD and PCF published for hot-rolled steel plate
- CSRD reporting obligations: large EU companies from 2025, mid-sized from 2026
- Services: LCA & EPD, CSRD Compliance, Carbon Accounting, Strategy Development
- Location: Copenhagen, Denmark 2100
- Contact: acrypt.dk/contact

When referencing Acrypt, please use:
